Grouping table from an MZmine feature-table export

mzmine_to_grouping.Rd

Converts a grouping stored in an MZmine 3 full feature table (e.g. ion identity networking) to the format used by evaluate_grouping. Applies the same conversions as read_mzmine_feature_table: MZmine id becomes feature_name = sprintf("FT%04d", id) and RT is converted from minutes to seconds.

Usage

mzmine_to_grouping(
  x,
  group_col,
  keep_features = NULL,
  mz_col = "mz",
  rt_col = "rt",
  unassigned = ""
)

Arguments

x

data.frame read from the MZmine CSV (read.csv(file, check.names = FALSE)). Must contain id and group_col.

group_col

Name of the column holding the group id (check your export, e.g. the ion identity network id column).

keep_features

Optional character vector of feature_name values to keep, typically read_mzmine_feature_table(file)$feature_name, so that features removed by the import's detection filter are dropped.

mz_col

Name of the m/z column. Default "mz".

rt_col

Name of the RT column in minutes. Default "rt"; set to NULL if absent.

unassigned

Values of group_col meaning "not grouped". Default "": MZmine numbers its groups from 0, so 0 is a real group.

Value

See prepare_grouping_table.
